intro: Silica brings brilliance to your dining space. With a toughened glass top, sleek black frame, and sculptural design, the Silica table turns every meal into a modern moment.

features.title: Clarity that captivates
features.text: A clear 8 mm toughened glass top brings elegance, durability, and a touch of transparency to your space.

features.title: Solid at the center
features.text: A stainless steel disc holds it all together—adding a subtle shine and secure, seamless structure.

features.title: Geometry in motion
features.text: The unique tetrahedral understructure doesn't just support—it elevates the entire design with sculptural appeal.

features.title: Matte black magic
features.text: Powder-coated legs in a deep matte black add contrast and style, while resisting wear and tear beautifully.

features.title: Style, space, and sense
features.text: Designed to fit modern homes, its compact form brings big impact without taking up too much space.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
